description: Random voltage source made from white noise run through a five band graphic equaliser at extremely low frequencies, so the mix of slow and less slow wandering is set band by band

params.text: Sets how much of that band goes into the output, on an audio taper
Sets the base frequency of the equaliser, 0.1Hz to 2Hz, placing the five bands at that frequency and at two, four, eight and sixteen times it; each band's frequency is printed beside its knob

inputs.text: Sets the gain of that band through the knob beside it

outputs.text: The random voltage, -5V to 5V, or 0-10V when the menu is set to unipolar

menu: Extra Low Frequency — moves the base frequency range down to 0.01Hz to 0.2Hz
Unipolar — puts out 0-10V in place of the standard -5V to 5V
